title: NOBLE JUMP 17 – Arrival of Norwegian troops by C130
description:
On Tuesday 6th of June, the last troops participaing in NATO exercise Noble Jump 2017 arrived in Romania. A Hercules C130 from the Royal Norwegian Air Force landed in Sibiu International Airport at 16:30. On board, 32 soldiers from Brigade North in Norway and three pallets of cargo.

This contingent joins Norwegian troops already arrived in Cincu training area. It will complete the surveillance target acquisition unit ability of the exercise.
Major Steinar Holen, J4 Branch in North Brigade in Norway received the contingent. „After a couple hours of sleep, they’ll go directly on the field for 4 days training for target acquisition mission.”

Norwegian troops were the first and last deployed for NOBLE JUMP.

Journalists: Eloise Rossi and Dennis Tappe

00:02:20:02 [SOUNDBITE IN NORWEGIAN]. MAJOR Steinar HOLEN, JA Branch in Brigade North in Norway and commander of National Support Element for NOBLE JUMP 17.

“We had three aircraft last week. We were the first in and we are also the last to be deployed. And therefore we’re the end of the deployment of the exercise.”

“The soldiers were happy to be at last deployed to Romania. They had been envious of the people leaving last week. So now they are happy to be here and to start the exercise.”

“We are talking about 29 degrees plus and sun. And at home it snows. Why shouldn’t they be happy? They were waiting for this exercise and for this opportunity since an exercise with the VJTF brigade in Germany last year.”

00:03:00:17 (MS) MAJOR Steinar HOLEN, stand up during the Interview.
